data.short_description: South Block signed a lease to open in Eastern Market, with the storefront customer-ready in early 2027. The grand opening will feature a block party with a live DJ, family events, and free acai bowls for the first 100 visitors. The menu will include acai bowls, smoothies, toasts, and juices.

Construction has officially begun on 3 Guys Pizza Pies' new location at Wedgewood Commons. Ownership says a clear opening timeline is not yet available as equipment and work remain. The pizzeria already operates in Southaven and Lakeland.

Connie's Chicken is opening its fourth location in Olive Branch, with owners anticipating being customer-ready in early October. The restaurant uses fresh, never-frozen ingredients and a seed-oil-free recipe cooked in 100% beef tallow. Existing locations are in Oxford, Tupelo, and Starkville.

Alfresco Flavas Bar N Grill has filed papers to open on Madison Avenue, with a certificate of occupancy under review as of July 23. The 2,600-square-foot restaurant with brew pub is registered to James Smith, the restaurateur behind Flava House.

El Metate is planning to open in Wheaton and has applied for a New Class B, Beer, Wine & Liquor License. The 1,796-square-foot Mexican restaurant will feature indoor dining, a bar, and an outdoor cafe.

data.location: 244 19th Ct S, Suites #10 and 15, Arlington, VA 22202
data.short_description: Tiki Thai's opening has been pushed back due to permitting delays and is now poised to open in summer 2027. The restaurant fuses fine Thai dining with a tiki aesthetic and will be located on the ground floor of the Reva apartment building. It will be Tiki Thai's second location, joining one already open in Reston.

data.location: Top of the Sipp, Southaven, Mississippi
data.short_description: Sips Dirty Soda Shop, the first Sips location in DeSoto County, plans to open at Top of the Sipp in Southaven in 2026. The menu will feature dirty sodas, Dirty Alani Energy Drinks, Red Bull Infusions, Dippin' Dots Floats, and seasonal specialties. Owners plan to grow throughout DeSoto County.

The Storehouse is preparing to open in downtown Livermore, with an ABC license application filed by Good Manor LLC. Previously introduced as The Storehouse – New Provisions, the concept is a micro food hall planned for the former Pennyweight Craft Brewing site. Plans include indoor and outdoor vendor spaces, pop-up businesses, shared seating, and space for restaurants, beverage operators, and boutique retailers.

data.location: 388 Grand Ave, South San Francisco, CA 94080
data.short_description: Joya Supermarket is preparing to open at 388-390 Grand Ave., offering grocery items from Mexico, Peru, and Guatemala, along with fresh produce, dairy, and pan dulce. Renovations and additional product offerings will be introduced as work continues.

data.location: 388 Grand Ave, South San Francisco, CA 94080
data.short_description: Joya Taqueria is scheduled to open inside the new Joya Supermarket in January. The initial menu will include tacos, burritos, and quesabirrias, with plans to add a deli counter serving Mexican tortas and other sandwiches.

data.location: 3616 W Spring Mountain Rd, Las Vegas, NV 89102
data.short_description: Lilli is expected to open its permanent location in Las Vegas' Chinatown within the Lotus Center, following a successful residency at Durango Social Club. The menu, centered on American ingredients through French technique with Mediterranean influence, will offer a four-course prix fixe, seven-course tasting menu, and à la carte lounge options.

Island Grill American Mediterranean plans to open its sixth Greater Houston location in the 4,225-square-foot River Oaks Village space in spring 2027. The address is currently home to Relish Restaurant & Bar, which will move to Transwestern's The RO by the end of the year.
Relish Restaurant & Bar announced it will be moving to Transwestern's The RO, and plans to stay at its current River Oaks Village location until the end of the year.

data.location: 3542 S Maryland Pkwy Unit FC6, Las Vegas, NV 89169
data.short_description: Luis's Kitchen is expected to open a new location inside The Boulevard mall in the Winchester neighborhood this summer, barring permitting. The eatery specializes in a multi-cultural fusion of Italian, Guatemalan, and Mexican dishes.

Lorella is preparing to open in the former Bagelry space in Russian Hill and is expected to debut this fall. Run by pastry chef Melissa Loar and chef-owner Melissa Perello, the bakery will offer seasonal breads, laminated pastries, and desserts, with the menu also expected to include pizza, cakes, and ice cream.

data.store_name: Truluck's Ocean's Finest Seafood and Crab
data.location: 791 Town and Country Blvd, Suite 160, Houston, TX 77024
data.short_description: Truluck's Ocean's Finest Seafood and Crab is planning its third Houston-region location in Town & Country Village, aiming for a February 14, 2027 opening barring construction and permitting. The brand currently has 12 restaurants across four regions.

Tender Heart Thrift is preparing to open a storefront in the Tenderloin as one of 39 recipients selected for funding through San Francisco's Vacant Storefronts program. No opening date has been disclosed.

Kong Mountain Tea is set to open its inaugural traditional Chinese tea room in Harvard Square on August 30, 2026, pending construction and final inspections. The 14- to 15-seat space will offer premium loose-leaf teas, paired pastries, and ticketed tea tastings.
Acai Fresh is preparing to expand beyond its Davis flagship with two new locations planned in Sacramento. Customers can choose from customizable acai bowls, signature bowls, and smoothies.

Acai Fresh is planning three new locations in the Walnut Creek area as part of its next phase of growth. The brand launched in Davis in 2024 and offers customizable acai bowls, signature bowls, and smoothies.

Koro Ramen & Sushi has announced plans to open a second location in Revere featuring the same menu as its original East Boston restaurant, including ramen, sushi, poke bowls, bao buns, gyoza, and wings. An official opening date has not yet been announced.

Dude IDK is planned as an entertainment venue at Denver's York Street Yards with room for up to 210 guests, hosting live comedy, music, podcasts, bingo, and trivia. The space will include a stage, bar, green room, sound booth, kitchen, and mobile stage. Food will be a significant part of the experience, with lunch and evening menus.

Tadaima is preparing to open a new Financial District cafe in the former Orale Orale restaurant space. The Japanese sando and matcha shop will offer onigiri, musubi, matcha beverages, and Japanese sandos. Existing locations are in the Mission, Marina, and Inner Sunset.

data.location: 2301 W Parmer Lane, Unit 204, Cedar Park, TX (Williamson County)
data.short_description: According to public filings, Jersey Mike's Subs plans to open a new location at 2301 W Parmer Lane, Unit 204, in Cedar Park, with construction completion in October 2026. Franchisee Jason Odom did not respond to inquiries about an opening timeline.

data.location: Jade Promenade, 3845 W Pioneer Ave, Las Vegas, NV 89102
data.short_description: PK Oyster Bar is opening a second location at Jade Promenade in Chinatown, near Spring Mountain Road and Wynn Road. The Cajun and Creole eatery, founded in 2020, will expand from its original Historic Commercial Center District location.

data.location: 14128 West Newberry Road, Unit C-13, Newberry, FL 32669
data.short_description: Ben & Jerry's is opening a new locally owned scoop shop in the Steeplechase area near Gainesville. Franchise owner Heali Mehta is targeting the third week of August for opening and plans to engage with the local community.

data.location: 918 Santa Maria Blvd, St. Augustine, FL 32086
data.short_description: Proof It Bagels will open its first brick-and-mortar location at 918 Santa Maria Blvd in St. Augustine, confirmed by owner Mostafa Abdelhamid. Menu details and opening date remain limited.

Bubba's 33, a Texas Roadhouse concept, plans to open a new location at 5085 George Bush Highway in Garland, expected fall 2027, per Regional Partner Stefan Gentry. The chain is also expanding to Grand Prairie.

Seoul Soul restaurant is planned for The Palms at Gate Parkway with a 2,980-square-foot interior build-out, per city permit records. Lloyd's Construction & Consulting LLC is the contractor; menu and opening timeline are not yet announced.

data.location: SilverLeaf Commons, 70 Silver Frst Dr, St. Augustine, FL 32092
data.short_description: Natural Greens is planning a second location at SilverLeaf Commons in St. Johns County, opening late 2026 per the Jacksonville Business Journal. The Mediterranean concept currently operates at 90 Durbin Pavilion Drive in Jacksonville.
N/A

Chicken Salad Chick plans to open at a Kroger-anchored shopping center in Rockwall, per public filings, with an opening expected by end of 2026, confirmed by J&M Hospitality partner Meggie Schissler. Grand opening will include a week of giveaways including free chicken salad for a year.

Little Lounge Play Cafe, a cafe and indoor playground, is preparing to open in Myrtle Beach. Owner Jatasha Greenway conceived the idea during COVID and designed it to include a parlor area, four themed playhouses, and beverages/snacks.

Paperwork submitted to the Town of Lexington shows a new Jim 'N Nick's Bar-B-Q planned for 5101 Sunset Blvd. The location would join Lexington Pavilion alongside retailers such as Best Buy, Target, Five Guys, Chicken Salad Chick, and Crumbl.

Taquería de Diez plans to open at 3023 Guadalupe St, per public filings, with founder Raul Esquer targeting mid-September, around Mexico's Independence Day. The space previously housed Chango's Taquería.
Taquería de Diez is planning a Domain location through a deal with Simon Group, potentially opening by end of 2026, near Q2 Stadium.
A third Taquería de Diez location at 500 E. 6th St. is expected to follow in Q1 or Q2 of 2027.

data.short_description: Westbound & Down Brewing Company announced a new restaurant and taproom at 5540 W. 29th Avenue in Wheat Ridge, expected late 2026 or early 2027. The 4,000-square-foot space will include 18 taps and a full kitchen with pizzas, sandwiches and pub fare.

data.short_description: NUBO, a new bakery, will open at 520 Cleveland Street in Clearwater, between North Osceola Avenue and North Fort Harrison Avenue. Menu details remain undisclosed but the opening is expected in August.

Jersey Mike's Subs plans a new Denver location at a Safeway-anchored shopping center at 20th Avenue and Washington Street, per plans submitted to the City of Denver. The proposed renovations include new walls, lighting, plumbing, kitchen equipment, and updates to the dining room, service counter and beverage station.

M and M Kitchen, a Memphis-area Afro-Caribbean food truck, is preparing to open its first brick-and-mortar in a 2,120-square-foot Second Street storefront, with a certificate of occupancy under review as of July 20. The menu features dishes like oxtail pasta, jollof rice, and jerk meats.

Texas franchisee Lone Star Bagels confirmed the project but declined to share a specific opening date. This marks the first confirmed Austin location under a deal to bring at least 12 shops to Texas.

Terra Modern American is a restaurant opening inside the lobby at Society Orlando from Thriving Hospitality. Executive chef and partner Ryan Stewart is leading the kitchen, with plans to serve breakfast, lunch and dinner alongside a large central bar. No opening date has been announced yet.

Gump's Golden Griddle, a family-owned diner, is preparing to open at 200 Barton Boulevard in Rockledge. It will join a retail center home to New Hong Kong Restaurant, Taco Bell, and a soon-to-open Spirit Halloween.
A Spirit Halloween retail store is soon-to-open at the retail center at 200 Barton Boulevard in Rockledge, joining tenants including New Hong Kong Restaurant and Taco Bell.

data.location: 12495 SW Community Blvd, Port St. Lucie, FL 34987
data.short_description: Ristorante Chef Luca Corleone is opening this August in Port St. Lucie serving authentic regional Italian cuisine. The restaurant will join the Publix-anchored Riverland Town Center.

A new Jersey Mike's Subs is preparing to open at 2210 Wellington St. in Middleton, per recently submitted plan review paperwork confirmed by the Jersey Mike's website. Franchise owner Brian Kenny was not immediately available for comment.

data.location: Downtown Tempe (exact address not yet announced)
data.short_description: Shawarmaati Mediterranean Grill is preparing to expand to downtown Tempe in late August, marking its third Valley location. The exact address has not been announced, and owner Mahdi Hammoud is still finalizing plans.

data.short_description: Connect International Church filed a tenant build-out permit for CIC Coffee at 925 Behrman Hwy Suite A in Terrytown. The church's website notes its facility is "under construction."

data.short_description: EggBred is getting ready to open a new fast-casual breakfast location at 16621 Dove Canyon Road in San Diego's 4S Ranch, owned by franchisees Armando Ponce Perez and Mariela Ponce. Documents were submitted to the San Diego Department of Environmental Health and Quality. No exact opening date announced.
EggBred previously announced plans for a location at 2810B El Cajon Boulevard, in addition to its new 4S Ranch site.
Stout's Coffee is planning a new drive-thru location in Devine as a $500,000 ground-up construction project. Work is expected to begin Aug. 1, 2026, and be completed by Dec. 31, 2026.

data.location: 14030 South Padre Island Drive, Corpus Christi, TX
data.short_description: Surfing Crab is planning a new location at 14030 South Padre Island Drive in Corpus Christi, renovating existing retail space in a $400,000 project scheduled to begin Aug. 29, 2026 and finish by Feb. 20, 2027. No exact opening date announced.

data.short_description: Surfing Crab is planning a new location at Five Points Shopping Center at 4101 Interstate Highway 69 Access Road, Suite B5, in Calallen. The company lists both new Corpus Christi locations as coming soon.

Jjang Korean BBQ is getting ready to open a second location at 329 West Felicita Avenue in Escondido's Felicita Plaza, taking over the former Sierra Madre Cantina space. Documents were submitted to the San Diego Department of Environmental Health and Quality.

Pasta On The Fly is planning a new location at 2325 Metairie Rd. in Metairie per a permit filing with Jefferson Parish. The restaurant has not announced whether this is a relocation or a second location.

data.location: 9739 N Sam Houston Pkwy E, Suite #170, Humble, TX 77396
data.short_description: Fighting Crab is set to open in the Canyon Lakes Shopping Center in the Park Lakes area of Humble, taking over a former Nice Furniture space. Construction is planned for an early August start and slated to wrap up by mid-November, with an expected fall opening.
Rooted, a health-focused eatery built around meals with seven ingredients or fewer, will open its second location at 581 Hudson St. in the West Village starting fall 2026. Construction is underway.

Peppino's Pizza & Trattoria, owned by Hank and Gia Mazzola, will debut its second location at 681 E. Evesham Rd. in Runnemede. The team finalized the deal on July 15 and has not yet announced an opening date.

data.location: 4855 Roosevelt Ave., Suite 100, San Antonio, TX 78234
data.short_description: A dual-branded Dunkin' and Jimmy John's drive-thru restaurant is planned for 4855 Roosevelt Ave., Suite 100 in San Antonio per a TDLR filing. Construction is expected to begin in September and wrap up by the end of January 2027, with Andy Ali listed as franchisee owner.

Levain Bakery has chosen Nashville's 12 South neighborhood for its first Tennessee location at 2901 12th Avenue South, taking over the former Burger Up space. An opening timeline has not been announced.

Burger Up is vacating its longtime 12 South space at 2901 12th Avenue South to make way for Levain Bakery. Owner Jim Lewis welcomed the transition, saying he is excited to see the space begin its next chapter.

data.location: 5734 UTSA Blvd., Suites 105-107, San Antonio, TX 78249
data.short_description: Sora Sushi, from restaurateur Zengfu Zheng, is planned for The Merc at 5734 UTSA Blvd., Suites 105-107, per a TDLR filing. Construction is scheduled to begin August 15 and wrap up December 1, with The Merc's first concepts expected to begin opening in early 2027.
The Crispy Chick, owned by Senayt Fekadu, is expanding to 6671 Pearl Road in Parma Heights as its second location. Construction is already underway, with owner targeting a September opening.

data.location: 403 Madison Lane North, Bainbridge Island, WA 98110
data.short_description: Thuy's Vietnamese Restaurant on Bainbridge Island is preparing to shut down after nearly 20 years, with September 8, 2026 set as its final day of service. Owner Thuy Nguyen shared the closure announcement on social media and hopes to spend time with family.
Au Bon Coin is a French bistro planned for 724 N. Broadway in Knoxville, taking over the former Donut Shop. It comes from the owners of Potchke and A Dopo.
Madman Espresso, a NYC coffee shop co-founded in 2012 by Marco Vacchi and Michele Civelli, will open at 646 9th Ave. It will be their eighth Manhattan location.

Andia's Ice Cream is planning two additional Triangle-area locations targeted for mid-2027 and 2028, though no specific addresses have been selected. The Cary-based brand currently operates three shops plus a Durham pop-up.
Second additional Triangle-area location targeted for 2028; no specific community or address has been selected yet. Family-owned brand founded in Cary in 2017.

Andia's Ice Cream is preparing to open a new 13,352-square-foot production, warehouse, and office facility at 1519 Brookside Drive in Raleigh. It will consolidate operations currently spread across multiple locations.

Stout, an elevated sports bar owned by Martin Whelan, will open at 373 Park Ave. S., marking its fifth New York City location. The bar features shareable plates, burgers, Wisconsin-style thin-crust pizza, and a curated beer and cocktail selection.
data.location: 373 Park Ave. S., New York, NY 10016

data.short_description: Heights Brewing, a gluten-free taproom in downtown Farmington operated by Ryan Kavanagh and Shawn MacDonnell, will permanently close on August 2, 2026 after two years in business. Owners cited rising costs, loan payments, and financial pressures.

data.short_description: Tavern in the Square has temporarily closed its Burlington restaurant at 100 District Avenue for a major renovation featuring updated color treatments, modern fixtures, and new lighting. It is part of Broadway Hospitality Group.

Tavern in the Square is preparing to debut a new restaurant in the former Bertucci's space at 435 Andover Street in North Andover. It is part of Broadway Hospitality Group's growing New England chain.

data.status: under construction; listed opening date is Aug. 27

data.short_description: The Audrey Restaurant & Bar, a Hollywood-inspired concept honoring Audrey Hepburn, is opening its second Houston location on August 5 on the first floor of Aspire Post Oak. The menu features seafood towers, truffle mushroom ravioli, beef Wellington, and premium steaks.

Pura Vida Miami, an all-day cafe founded in 2012 in South Florida by Omer and Jen Horev, has its first Long Beach location in the works at 2ND & PCH, taking over the former Noble Rotisserie space. The brand has 55 locations nationwide.
data.location: 6460 E. Pacific Coast Hwy, Suite 125, Long Beach, CA 90803

data.short_description: Kind Brew Cafe and Creamery, a new drive-thru cafe from first-time owner Brandon Grosz, is planned for 5466 N Milwaukee Avenue in Jefferson Park in the former Bank of America building. It will serve coffee, tea, frozen custard, sandwiches, and pastries.

Alatri Bros., a family-owned Italian restaurant and pizzeria operated by Roberto and Riccardo Pietrobono, will close after a 10-year run with a final day of service on Friday, July 24. The space will continue to host private events.

Swig, a fast-growing beverage chain founded in 2010 in St. George, Utah, is planning a new Bellevue-area location at 7661 Highway 70 S. in the Galleries at Bellevue shopping center. It is known for customizable "dirty sodas."

Jersey Mike's Subs will open a new location this fall at Bethlehem Square, with franchise owner Gerrit Curran leading the operation. The sub shop was founded in 1956 and now operates more than 3,000 locations.

HTeaO, a premium iced tea chain, is celebrating the grand opening of its new El Campo location on August 1 at 606 N. Mechanic. It is owned by first-time franchisees Brandon Somers, Joanie Roome, and Sandra Smolik Alexander.

El Pollo Sabroso, a family-owned Colima-style Mexican restaurant owned by Valentin Lopez, is opening a second Pasco location at 1304 N. 4th Ave. per a filed Washington State liquor license. The original opened in 2020 at 1623 W. Lewis St.

Amor Y Queso, a cheese and charcuterie shop owned by Sarah Carlock, has permanently closed its Deep Ellum storefront after six years, shortly after a reopening. Owner cited financial losses and rising crime in the neighborhood.

Refuge Coffee Co., a Georgia-based nonprofit that trains and employs resettled refugees, is celebrating the grand opening of its Lulah Hills location on July 27 — its fourth retail location in metro Atlanta. The cafe occupies a former Meineke auto shop within the 78-acre Lulah Hills redevelopment.

Bojangles confirmed another company-owned restaurant is planned for Murfreesboro Pike. That location is also expected to open during the fourth quarter of this year.
